release_notes: The HIKMICRO HM-TD7168-75 is a thermal panoramic scanner with a continuously spinning 640x512 12 um VOx thermal module giving full 360 perimeter detection, dynamic fire detection (up to 200 points) and alarm linkage to slave PT cameras for target tracking. Used in coastal security and critical infrastructure such as oilfields and airports. Verified against the official HIKMICRO datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal panoramic scanner; single thermal channel.
